patterns_noted: First cycle observations: (1) On severe down days with tech leading (-6.66% XLK), the Bear's caution about staying cash-heavy proved compelling — I deployed only ~31% of capital vs Bull's 90% suggestion. (3) The Bear's curve-flattening argument against XLF was decisive and caused me to eliminate a trade the Bull had at 0.65 confidence — always check internal logical consistency of thesis (higher short rates ≠ steeper curve). (5) Position sizing discipline: on a down day with unresolved macro catalyst (jobs/rate repricing), holding 60%+ cash is correct even if it means missing some upside. Beat benchmarks by not losing, not just by winning.
